The '''MX9''' was a type of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] that appeared in a short story by an unspecified party that was posted on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The tale depicted the MX9 rifle as a standard issue weapon in the [[Thaereian military]] with components that included a [[mesobanis timer]] and a [[symon tube]]. The tale showed the protagonist, the [[Thaereian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Nightwing]], attempting to repair his jammed MX9 rifle from his [[Sleeper (furniture)|bunk]] in a Thaereian military [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]].<ref name="the best defense" />
